Commentary.Commentary: So, the target for the hosts is 262 and it will not be an easy task. South Africa are known to crumble under pressure. Can they chase this score down or will Bangladesh enter the semi-finals? Join us in a while to find out.

South Africa, on the other hand, would be disappointed with their performance as they had a good bowling line-up at their disposal but they could not make use of the conditions and let Bangladesh post a good score on this wicket. Dropped catches did not help either. Pheku Moletsane was the pick of the bowlers while Coetzee too bowled well. Achille Cloete and Tiaan van Vuuren did not make much of an impact.

A good finish for Bangladesh. They will fancy themselves to defend this score. They started well with a 60-run stand between the openers but they slowed down after that and were just going at around 4.5 runs per over. They lost 2 quick wickets but the partnership between Towhid Hridoy and Shahadat Hossain was the game-changer. Their stand of 102 runs was a crucial one as they reached a very good score of 261/5. That score on this pitch is very good and it was just two days back when India defended a score around 230.

FOUR! Pulled away nicely! Short ball on middle, Hossain Emon pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. First boundary of the bat.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around middle, Hossain Emon ducks under it.
Full delivery on off, Hasan defends it towards mid off and takes a single. The fielder runs ahead and then dives in an attempt to throw it to the stumps but fails to collect the ball cleanly.
LEG BYES! Good length ball down the leg side, Tanzid looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls to fine leg and the batters take a couple of leg byes.
Good length ball on middle, Hossain Emon works it to square leg.
Back of a length ball outside off, Hossain Emon leaves it alone.

An appeal for LBW turned down! Full delivery on the pads, Hossain Emon looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The South African players appeal but the umpire is not interested. Maybe the ball was pitching outside leg.
Good length ball on middle, worked to the leg side for a single.
Short ball around off, Tanzid looks to defend but it hits the gloves and lobs towards point. Luckily for him, it lands in front of the point fielder.
Fullish delivery on middle, Tanzid flicks it to mid-wicket.
Shortish in length, Hossain Emon pulls it to mid-wicket.
Cloete dishes a fuller one on middle, Hossain Emon tucks it to mid-wicket.
Full delivery on middle, Hossain Emon defends it back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Back of a length ball outside off, Hossain Emon looks to cut but fails to make any connection.

TOP EDGE BUT SAFE! Short ball on middle, Tanzid looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes towards fine leg. The fielder runs in from fine leg but the ball falls short. The batsmen take a single.
Short ball on middle, Hasan looks to pull but it takes the inside half of the bat and goes onto hit the pads.

BEATEN! That's an absolute gem of a delivery! Length ball on off, moving away from the batsman. Hossain Emon looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it. On any other day, it could have been a wicket.
Good length ball on off, Hossain Emon solidly defends it to cover.
Very full delivery on off, Parvez drives but finds the cover fielder who collects it on the bounce.
Full delivery on middle, Hossain Emon flicks it to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! This is the line and length to bowl. This is excellent bowling. On a length outside off, Hossain Emon looks to drive but fails to get any bat on it.

FIVE WIDES! Coetzee bowls a bouncer around middle, Hossain Emon ducks under it. The keeper jumps and tries to collect with one hand but fails to do so. The ball goes into the fence and the umpire signals it as five wides.
Full delivery on off, Hossain Emon pushes it to cover.
Good length delivery on the pads, Hossain Emon looks to flick but  it takes the inside half of the bat and rolls to square leg for a single. 4 runs off Cloete's first.
Full delivery outside off, Hasan drives it to deep point for a single.
Cloete bowls a full delivery on the pads, Hossain Emon tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Fullish ball on off, Parvez prods forward and defends it to cover.
Length ball outside off, Hossain Emon lets the ball through to the keeper.
First run of the bat. Cloete starts with a full delivery on the pads, Tanzid works it to deep square leg for a single.
Achille Cloete to bowl from the other end.
FOUR LEG BYES! Bangladesh are underway! Good length ball down the leg side, Emon looks to flick but it hits the thigh pad and goes to the fine leg region for four leg byes. Good start from Coetzee.
Length ball on middle, Hossain Emon looks to defend but it hits the handle of the bat and goes towards the bowler.
Fullish ball on middle, Parvez defends it to mid off.
Fullish ball outside off, angling in. Hossain Emon makes another leave. Good start from Coetzee.
Good length ball outside off, Hossain Emon shoulders arms.
BEATEN! What a start from Coetzee. He starts with a yorker outside off, Hossain Emon looks to drive but misses and the ball goes into the mitts of the keeper.

Both the teams are ready for their respective national anthems. We are all set to begin. The South African players are out in the middle. Tanzid Hasan and Parvez Hossain Emon will open the batting for Bangladesh. Gerald Coetzee will start the proceedings for South Africa.

Akbar Ali, Bangladesh skipper says that he would have bowled too but the toss is not in his hands. Adds that they would look to put a good total on the board. Goes on to say that the top order need to put their hands up and give the bowlers a good score to defend.

Bryce Parson, South Africa skipper says that they would bowl first. Says that the first game was a struggle and they were taking each game as a knockout game. Adds that they are happy to play at home and there is added pressure. Informs of two changes.

Pitch report - JP Duminy is there for the pitch report, he says that the pitch has good bounce and has turn and bounce as well. Rohan Gavaskar says that there are lot of runs on offer and if the batsmen give themselves time on this pitch, they can score runs.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Parvez Hossain Emon, Tanzid Hasan, Mahmudul Hasan Joy, Towhid Hridoy, Shahadat Hossain, Akbar Ali (C/WK), Shamim Hossain, Hasan Murad (In for Avishek Das), Tanzim Hasan Sakib, Rakibul Hasan, Shoriful Islam.

South Africa U19 (Playing XI) - Jonathan Bird, Khanya Cotani (WK), Bryce Parsons (C), Luke Beaufort, Tyrese Karelse, Tiaan van Vuuren, Jack Lees, Pheku Moletsane, Achille Cloete, Gerald Coetzee (In for Merrick Brett), Mondli Khumalo (In for Odirile Modimokoane).
Toss - South Africa have won the toss and they choose to bowl first.

South Africa, after being humbled in their match against Afghanistan have bounced back really well to enter the quarter-finals and they would look to enter the final four with a dominating win against the Bangla Tigers. Bangladesh, on the other hand, have been unbeaten with one game being abandoned. Bangladesh look favourites. Surprised, don't be as they have played some good cricket throughout the tournament. Toss and team updates in a while.
